summary: Completed testing of Client Portal Web features. All backend APIs (15/15 tests passed) and frontend UI components working correctly. Portal dashboard displays client summary stats, devis/factures lists with tabs, PDF downloads, and devis signature flow.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/portal/client/{token} correctly returns client, entreprise, devis, factures, interventions, and summary stats
GET /api/portal/facture/{facture_id}?token=xxx properly validates client token before returning facture details
GET /api/portal/facture/{facture_id}/pdf?token=xxx generates valid PDF with correct content-type header
GET /api/clients/{id}/portal-link generates portal_token on first request if not exists, requires authentication
Frontend ClientPortalDashboard component has proper tabs (Aperçu, Devis, Factures) with correct data display
Frontend ClientDetail page has 'Obtenir lien portail client' button that generates and displays portal link with copy functionality
Summary calculations (montant_du, devis_en_attente, devis_signes) are correctly computed from factures/devis data
seed_data_creation: Used existing client Martin Pierre with portal_token. Created TEST_ prefixed client during testing (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Client Portal features fully tested. Key findings: 1) Portal dashboard at /portal/client/:token shows summary cards (devis count, factures count, amount due), tabs for overview/devis/factures, 2) Devis can be viewed and signed from portal, 3) Factures have PDF download buttons that work correctly, 4) Client detail page has 'Obtenir lien portail client' button that generates portal_token if not exists and displays copyable link, 5) All portal endpoints are public (no auth required) but validate client token.

test_1_portal_dashboard_api.evidence: Returns client, entreprise, devis list, factures list, interventions list, and summary stats

test_2_portal_dashboard_invalid_token.evidence: Invalid UUID token correctly returns 404 Accès non autorisé

test_3_portal_facture_detail.evidence: Returns facture, client, and entreprise data with all fields

test_4_portal_facture_pdf.evidence: PDF generated with correct content-type and %PDF header

test_5_portal_link_generation.description: GET /api/clients/{id}/portal-link generates token if not exists
test_5_portal_link_generation.evidence: New client gets portal_token generated, existing client returns existing token

test_7_frontend_portal_dashboard.evidence: Header with company name, summary cards, tabs (Aperçu/Devis/Factures), contact section, footer

test_8_frontend_devis_tab.description: Devis tab shows table with all devis
test_8_frontend_devis_tab.evidence: Table with columns: Numéro, Date, Validité, Montant TTC, Statut, Actions (Voir button)

test_9_frontend_factures_tab.description: Factures tab shows table with PDF download buttons
test_9_frontend_factures_tab.evidence: Table with 7 columns including PDF download links that work correctly

test_10_frontend_devis_detail.description: Clicking Voir on devis navigates to devis portal page
test_10_frontend_devis_detail.evidence: Devis detail page shows with Signer le devis and Télécharger PDF buttons

test_11_frontend_client_detail_portal_li.description: Client detail page has portal link button
test_11_frontend_client_detail_portal_li.evidence: Button generates link, displays in input field, copy button works

test_12_summary_calculations.evidence: montant_du, devis_en_attente, devis_signes match calculated values from data

public_endpoints: GET /api/portal/client/{token} - Dashboard with all client data
authenticated_endpoints: GET /api/clients/{id}/portal-link - Generate/get portal link for client
